messages:
Alex: cutting RC from branch release/rc-2026-05 now — bump to 1.4.0-rc1, no hot migrations. planning staged promo in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window.
Priya: quick question — any schema migrations or long-running jobs?
Alex: no schema changes. there is a small background job change behind a feature flag (off by default). verified locally.
Mike: sounds good, what artifact tag will we pin?
Alex: pinning gcr.io/redwood/realtime:1.4.0-rc1 and inference-runtime:1.4.0-rc1.
Priya: adding a note to release notes to mention the background job flag and rollback steps.
Alex: command I used:
```
./scripts/cut_rc.sh release/rc-2026-05 --bump-version=1.4.0-rc1 --manifest=prod
```
Dena: can we get oncall smoke before promo? I want a fast verification checklist.
sre-oncall: I'll run smoke — give me the smoke checklist and I'll start.
Alex: smoke checklist:
- health endpoints for runtime +1
- sample generation on small prompt set (latency & correctness)
- redis/KV connectivity
- autoscaler metrics sane
(should be <10m)
sre-oncall: starting smoke now.
deploy-bot: rc-originate job queued: job-id rc-originate-2465017890.
sre-oncall: smoke results: health OK, sample gen latency +5ms median, one minor tokenization mismatch in prompt #3 (expected variant, not regression). autoscaler metrics normal.
Dena: SGTM. no blockers from infra.
Mike: +1 for promote, prefer 10% cohort for 30m then lift to 50% if stable.
Priya: change window note: ops asked to avoid DB heavy traffic between 02:00-02:30 UTC. we should start at 02:15 to avoid batch jobs.
Alex: plan: promote 02:15 UTC, cohort 10% for 30m, if no errors lift to 50% for 30m, then full. rollback target if errors: pin back to inference-runtime:1.3.9 and realtime:1.3.9 (current prod).
Dena: rollback playbook:
- set routing to previous pin
- trigger canary rollback job: ./scripts/rollback.sh --tag=1.3.9
- pause ingesters if error flood
- notify customers via status page if >5% error rate
Alex: pinned artifacts pushed to registry. tag: gcr.io/redwood/realtime:1.4.0-rc1.
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: job-id rc-rollout-2465017890 cohort=10% duration=30m
Priya: added release notes entry and the rollback steps in the release doc (LINK: https://go/redwood/release/1.4.0-rc1).
Mike: watching metrics dashboard. alert thresholds set (5xx > 0.5% and latency p95 > 300ms).
deploy-bot: cohort 10% complete, no errors observed. moving to 50% per policy.
Alex: lifting to 50% now.
sre-oncall: performing targeted smoke on 50% cohort, tail logs for error spikes.
deploy-bot: cohort 50% complete, stability window passed 30m.
Alex: promoting to full prod now.
deploy-bot: promotion complete, job-id rc-rollout-2465017890 status=SUCCESS.
Mike: monitoring — metrics look clean, no regressions observed in first 15m.
Dena: verifying canary rollbacks not needed. all good.
Priya: finalizing release notes and changelog.
Alex: thanks everyone. closing promo thread. will keep watch for 1h then archive. :thumbsup:
